# Fail on new unresolved dispatches

Accept the dispatches Loom can't resolve today and fail the build on any new one.

```bash
# Once, from a scan of your main branch:
mkdir -p .loom && cp storage/loom/index.json .loom/baseline.json

# On every branch:
php artisan loom:scan
php artisan loom:check --baseline=.loom/baseline.json --skip=orphan-listeners --skip=orphan-events --skip=cyclic-dispatch
```

<!-- generated:output:check-new-unresolved -->

```text
unresolved-dispatches — No new unresolved dispatches (strict: none at all)
  ✗ Unresolved dispatch (dynamic_class_name) at app/Services/Notifier.php:9: event($eventClass)
1 violation(s) across 1 rule(s).
```
<!-- /generated:output:check-new-unresolved -->

Only the dispatch the branch added fails, and the command exits `1`. Entries match on file, line and expression, so moving old code makes it look new: refresh the baseline when you accept it. Drop the `--skip` options to run every [rule](../reference/check-rules-and-formats.md#rules); `--strict` fails on every unresolved dispatch.
